mechanism_narrative: The current level of the federal funds rate (at any level) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the cost of capital and boost equity valuations.
failure_condition: When the federal funds rate is above 4.0% and the 20-day forward return is negative, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the CPI index above 0.5% signals inflationary pressure that leads to a 20-day negative S&P 500 return, as the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns following a 3-month CPIAUCSL rise above 0.5% are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening economy that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following the joint condition (INDPRO decline and UNRATE rise) are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When residential fixed investment (RSAFS) falls below 500 million dollars and housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1.1 million units, it signals a housing market slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following the condition (RSAFS < 500.0 and HOUST < 1100.0) are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below the 2017 base level (100) signals a contraction in the manufacturing sector that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following INDPRO < 100 are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: The current level of residential fixed investment (RSAFS) (at any level) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, as higher investment in housing signals strong consumer demand and economic growth.
failure_condition: When RSAFS is above 600 million dollars and the 5-day forward return is negative, the hypothesis is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.0% signals a deteriorating labor market that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns following UNRATE > 4.0 are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and fall in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.1 million units signals a broad-based economic slowdown that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns following the joint condition (INDPRO decline and HOUST < 1100.0) are positive in more than 50% of cases, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
